rules.rule: If comparing screen RGB to generic CMYK output, expect electric magentas to appear as dusty pink-purple due to gamut shape differences.
rules.evidence: Pick the most electric magenta your screen can make and print it on an office printer. What comes back is a dusty pink-purple.

rules.rule: If judging colour accuracy for brand colours or spot inks, choose media-relative colorimetric intent instead of perceptual.
rules.evidence: For flat brand colour and spot inks, colorimetric is usually the right answer; perceptual is for photographs.

rules.rule: If converting files early in a pipeline, avoid it because every conversion throws away colours that cannot be recovered.
rules.evidence: Every conversion throws away colours you cannot get back. Stay in the wide space and convert once, late, to the profile the printer names.
